The Man Behind the Power

For leaders who have learned to carry responsibility, navigate complexity and remain in control – yet want a deeper relationship with themselves, others and the life they have built.

An embodied approach to greater coherence in how you lead, relate and live.

Begin a conversationPrivate work with Rina Trevi

You are already intelligent and capable. The question is what happens when the stakes become personal.

Intelligence, discipline and experience solve many problems. They cannot always prevent fear, urgency or old patterns from shaping how you lead, decide and relate.

This work develops five capacities for meeting those moments with greater awareness and coherence.

Perception

Read the room – and yourself.

Notice tension, desire and resistance before they become reaction or distance.

Regulation

Remain present under pressure.

Stay with intensity without becoming rigid, impulsive or unavailable.

Capacity for Uncertainty

Resist the demand for premature answers.

Hold complexity until a considered response can emerge.

Relational Courage

Tell the truth without retreating behind authority.

Navigate conflict, boundaries and vulnerability while remaining connected and self-possessed.

Conscious Power

Understand what is shaping your choices.

Recognize when fear, image or control is shaping a decision – and choose deliberately.

The Path

One path, five movements.

Five interconnected movements toward greater coherence in how you lead, relate and live.

Why it works

Insight is necessary. It is rarely sufficient.

Many intelligent men understand their patterns. Change begins when insight meets embodied experience, relational practice and sustained attention.

The mind can explain what the body continues to repeat.

Trauma and Somatics Training

The work respects the nervous system, personal boundaries and individual capacity.

More Than a Decade of Meditation Practice

Presence is grounded in sustained practice – not abstraction or performance.

Twelve Years Working with Power Dynamics

Firsthand understanding of authority, control, desire, trust and surrender in men’s inner and relational lives.

MBA and Business Fluency

An understanding of the pressures, responsibilities and complexities leaders navigate.

Two depths of engagement

Four months. Designed around the person.

Both engagements combine an opening half-day intensive, private counsel, embodied practice and integration. The difference is the depth and duration of the in-person work.

Private Counsel

$8,000/month · $32,000 total

  • Opening half-day intensive
  • One half-day immersion each month
  • Two private online sessions each month
  • Individual practices and structured experiments
  • Private reflection channel between meetings
  • Final integration and continuation review

Immersive Counsel

$15,000/month · $60,000 total

  • Opening half-day intensive
  • One private weekend each month
  • Weekly private online sessions
  • Individually designed embodied and relational work
  • Priority support between meetings
  • Final integration and continuation review

Two four-month cycles are offered each year. Each cycle is limited to one Immersive Counsel engagement or up to two Private Counsel engagements.

What the work can look like

Beyond conversation.

Immersion allows patterns to become visible through direct experience – not only through reflection.

Extended Dialogue

Follow a question beneath familiar explanations to the assumptions, conflicts and protective patterns underneath.

Embodied Inquiry

Work with sensation, breath, movement, tension and impulse as information not yet available in words.

Rope and Restraint

Use rope to encounter control, trust, resistance, receiving and surrender – not performance or spectacle.

Power and Surrender

Enter designed experiences that reveal how you respond when authority, choice, uncertainty or control begins to shift.

Relational Practice

Use honest contact and embodied practice to reveal patterns of trust, distance, control and vulnerability in real time. Deepen intimacy without abandoning your boundaries or yourself.

Shared Time and Integration

Allow conversation, silence, nature, meals and unstructured time to support what cannot be reached inside a conventional appointment.

No particular modality is assumed. Every immersion is individually designed, discussed in advance and grounded in clear purpose, consent and boundaries.

Your guide

Rina Trevi

Private Embodied Counsel

Rina’s work integrates embodiment, vulnerability, intimacy and power dynamics.

For twelve years, she worked internationally as a professional Dominatrix, developing a firsthand understanding of what accomplished men reveal when their public identities are no longer in the room.

Her approach draws on more than a decade of meditation and Tantric practice, with training in trauma and somatics, coaching and relational work. With an MBA, she also understands the realities leaders navigate.

She is neither impressed by status nor intimidated by intensity.

Rina is the author of Shibari as Ritual and the forthcoming Freedom Bound.

In short

Private counsel through embodiment, not conventional coaching.

Working with the moments that matter – so power is held consciously and life is lived more fully.
